summary.en: The exhibit look: real prints in neutral mounts on a light (or dark) desk under an overhead camera, label stock for mounts, chips and readings, one pencil for what the film points at.
summary.zh: exhibit 的样式：顶拍的浅色（或深色）桌面上，真实截图装在中性卡纸框里；框、标签、读数都用标签纸色，只有一支铅笔色标出片子正在指的东西。

fits: Launches argued from published evidence: official tables, charts, release pages, the product’s own screens.
notFor: Films with no real asset; dense dashboards; anything that needs a drawn UI.

intent.en: A curator’s desk: the evidence is real and untouched, the film only points at it with one pencil.
intent.zh: 策展人的工作台：证据真实、原样，片子只用一支铅笔去指。

content.en: 3–5 real captures (16:9 crops of ≥ 1200 × 675 source px), each with its source line; short captions (≤ 6 words / 16 字).
content.zh: 3–5 张真实截图（16:9 裁切，源像素 ≥ 1200 × 675），各带来源行；短说明（≤ 6 词 / 16 字）。

fits.zh: 用公开证据立论的发布：官方表格、图表、发布页、产品自己的界面。

notFor.zh: 没有真实素材的片子；密集的仪表盘；需要画界面的场合。

en: Ring one region at a time and keep the accent ΔE00 ≥ 20 from the colours inside it.
Assets are only cropped, scaled and veiled: never recolour or rebuild them.
zh: 一次只圈一处，强调色与圈内颜色 ΔE00 ≥ 20。
素材只裁切、缩放、加遮罩：不重新上色、不重画。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
